title: Phrasal verbs 2
note: Second lexis pack, on the three themes already played (work, travel, relationships) so every item lands on known ground. With pack 1 this hits the course-doc ~60. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: TWELVE of the 36 tiles were already taught — *fill in, take off, set off, turn up* belong to leaf_phrasal_1_b1 (path 45), *check in* to leaf_travel_b1 (6), *get on / get off* to leaf_get_b1 (43), *break up, make up, let down, fall out* to leaf_relationships_b1 (24) — and **get on was listed twice inside this pack itself**, in the travel block and the people block. F7: all twelve slots refilled with phrasal verbs that are new here — sort out, look round, drop in, see off, run into, stop off, put up with, cheer up, tell off, bring up, look down on, fall for. · sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma; four of the eight shipped frames used a past form or split the verb (*broke up*, *call you back*, *gave up*, *was held up*) and so produced no gap. Every frame here keeps its particle next to its verb. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 underlined paraphrases. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_phrasal_2_b1 — 0 unknown types.

intro.note: These are **pack 2**. Pack 1 has the everyday ones (turn on, tidy up, pick up) and b1_phrasal_verbs has the grammar of the split. Nothing here repeats those.
